integrity: The full all-degree theorem has an analytic inverse-branch/degree proof. Reproducibility checks are finite and do not substitute for a proof. Publication priority beyond inspected evidence is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Proves sharp periodic-point counts only for strict positive alternating trajectories in a fixed symmetric pair of centered linear oscillators, not a global census for every possible switch sequence. No global perturbation-uniform expansion or mixing is asserted.
title: A sharp all-period cycle census for polynomial-reset hybrid centers
